title: VEnron: A versioned spreadsheet corpus and related evolution analysis
abstract: Presents a semi-automated method that combines spreadsheet contents, filenames, and spreadsheet-attached emails to identify evolved spreadsheets and recover fragmented version information in the Enron email archive. The resulting VEnron corpus supports empirical analysis of formula changes and errors introduced during spreadsheet evolution.
venue: 5th International Workshop on Green and Sustainable Software (GREENS 2016), ICSE Companion

title: ClassSheets: automatic generation of spreadsheet applications from object-oriented specifications
abstract: Introduces an object-oriented specification language for representing spreadsheet structure at a level above individual cells and automatically generating spreadsheet applications from those specifications. It provides an early formal representation of repeated and hierarchical spreadsheet structures.
venue: 20th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Automated Software Engineering (ASE 2005)

title: CUSTODES: Automatic spreadsheet cell clustering and smell detection using strong and weak features
abstract: Clusters spreadsheet cells using strong and weak structural features and performs smell detection within the resulting groups. Its evaluation demonstrates automated recovery of semantically related cell regions despite variation in spreadsheet tabulation styles.
venue: IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering Companion (ICSE 2016)

title: BBox DocVQA: A Large Scale Bounding Box Grounded Dataset for Enhancing Reasoning in Document Visual Question Answer
abstract: Introduces a DocVQA dataset in which each question-answer instance is grounded to explicit bounding boxes rather than only a page or document. It includes single- and multi-region and single- and multi-page examples, uses human verification, and evaluates both localization and answer reasoning.
